This creates a potential pathway where Echothiophate may influence the therapeutic use of dichlorophen, potentially affecting its efficacy or safety profile in the treatment of Open-angle Glaucoma. The scores from the paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though further mechanistic validation is required to establish a direct causal link.
